sections.title: Question intonation
sections.content: A simple statement can be used as a yes/no question with question intonation and context: Te Meg *vagy*? Ez *egy* tea?

Hungarian yes/no questions don't just rise at the end the way English ones do — they follow a distinctive rise-then-fall "question tune," which can make them sound to English ears almost like a statement. Mimicking that tune will make you sound more natural than getting every word right in a flat voice.
